subtitle: The components inside the Planner API
desc: Inside the Planner API, routes call a meal planner, which loads recipes through a repository and asks Azure OpenAI for ideas through a suggestion client.

spa.name: Planner UI
spa.description: Lets the cook browse recipes and plan the week in a browser.

routes.name: Recipe Routes
routes.description: Handles requests for recipes, plans and shopping lists.

planner.name: Meal Planner
planner.description: Builds weekly plans and shopping lists from recipes.

suggest.name: Suggestion Client
suggest.description: Asks Azure OpenAI for recipes that use given ingredients.

repo.name: Recipe Repository
repo.description: Reads and writes recipes and plans in the database.

db.name: Recipe Database
db.description: Stores recipes, meal plans and shopping lists.

aoai.name: Azure OpenAI
aoai.description: Suggests recipes from a list of ingredients.
